onceuponatown.tooltip.mode_sell_desc: Sell resources in exchange for emeralds.
onceuponatown.tooltip.mode_sell_note: Only resources produced by the buildings are accepted.
onceuponatown.tooltip.medal.deposit_hint: Deposit in a village of the same culture to unlock.
onceuponatown.tooltip.village_banner.pla: Shift-click on the ground to found your village
onceuponatown.building.settlement.descri: An industrial settlement focused on stone extraction. Produces cobblestone and oak logs, and can smelt stone using charcoal.
onceuponatown.building.settlement_2.desc: A pastoral settlement built around animal husbandry. Raises pigs, sheep, cows and chickens over time, producing meat, wool, leather and eggs.
onceuponatown.building.settlement_3.desc: A farming settlement rooted in crop cultivation. Produces wheat and seeds, and can bake bread and roasted potatoes. The foundation of your food supply.
onceuponatown.building.starter.descripti: The heart of your village. Stores all village resources, manages the construction queue and defines the current era. Upgrade it to expand your settlement and unlock new buildings.
onceuponatown.building.house.description: A nicely looking house that shelters 2 residents, upgradeable to 3. Houses grow the village population and are required to unlock certain advanced buildings.
onceuponatown.building.house_2.descripti: A nicely looking house that shelters 2 residents, upgradeable to 3. Houses grow the village population and are required to unlock certain advanced buildings.
onceuponatown.building.house_3.descripti: A regular house that shelters 2 residents, upgradeable to 3. A different architectural layout from House 2.
onceuponatown.building.wild_stone.descri: A natural stone deposit that slowly yields cobblestone.
onceuponatown.building.stone_breach.desc: A basic quarry site with a resident miner who chips away at exposed rock. Produces cobblestone steadily from the very first era.
onceuponatown.building.mine.description: A key building for a decent cobblestone production. Unlock a miner that will dig deeper over time.
onceuponatown.building.open_mine.descrip: A large open-pit mine with a resident miner. Produces cobblestone, granite, andesite, diorite and tuff. Unlocks gravel, flint and eventually coal at higher upgrade levels.
onceuponatown.building.toolsmith.descrip: The perfect place if you need someone qualified enough to fix everything linked to rough materials.
onceuponatown.building.grove.description: A small grove of oak trees that provides a steady supply of oak logs.
onceuponatown.building.lumberjack.descri: A lumberjack's cabin with a resident woodcutter who actively chops grove trees and replants saplings. Produces logs, saplings, apples and sticks. Unlocks wood variants at higher levels.
onceuponatown.building.workshop.descript: The village's main crafting building. Transforms oak logs into planks, sticks, beds, stairs, slabs, fences, fence gates, trapdoors and doors.
onceuponatown.building.carpenter.descrip: A carpenter's workshop fully equipped. Specializes in precision crafting and produces chiseled bookshelves from planks and slabs.
onceuponatown.building.wild_crops.descri: A patch of wild vegetation that slowly grows wheat, seeds, carrots and potatoes.
onceuponatown.building.potato_farm.descr: A large potato farm that will produce more potatoes that you could think of. It just need the cheese now
onceuponatown.building.wheat_field.descr: A cultivated wheat field that grows wheat and seeds.
onceuponatown.building.wheat_farm.descri: A large farm built around wheat. Produces wheat and seeds, and transforms them into bread, and bone meal at higher levels.
onceuponatown.building.cow_field.descrip: A small cattle enclosure that produces beef and leather. The cows remains unfazed.
onceuponatown.building.cow_farm.descript: A large cattle farm with a resident cowherd. Produces beef and leather, and can cook beef with charcoal. The herd grows as the building is upgraded.
A leatherworker's shop that turns leather into full leather armor sets, item frames, saddles and name tags.
onceuponatown.building.pig_field.descrip: A small pig pen that produces porkchop. Beware the smell
onceuponatown.building.pig_farm.descript: A full pig farm with a resident swineherd. Produces and cooks porkchop using charcoal. The herd grows as the building is upgraded.
onceuponatown.building.sheep_field.descr: A small sheep pen that yields mutton and wool.
onceuponatown.building.sheep_farm.descri: A full sheep farm with a resident shepherd. Produces wool and mutton, and can cook mutton with charcoal. The herd grows as the building is upgraded.
onceuponatown.building.wild_bee.descript: This is a bee house, you should never ever try to cut down this tree.
onceuponatown.building.bee_field.descrip: A managed apiary built around bee hives. Produces honeycomb and is required to place the Beekeeper building.
onceuponatown.building.beekeeper.descrip: A beekeeper's cottage with a resident beekeeper. Produces honeycomb and transforms it into honeycomb blocks, honey bottles, candles and honey blocks at higher upgrade levels.
onceuponatown.building.lake.description: A small lake. Perfect for those who wanders.
onceuponatown.building.fisherman.descrip: A fisherman's dock that produces cod from the nearby lakes, and unlocks salmon and fish cooking with charcoal at higher upgrade levels.
onceuponatown.building.oven.description: A stone oven that burns oak logs into charcoal, cooks all types of meat and potatoes, and crafts torches.
onceuponatown.building.kitchen.descripti: A fully equipped kitchen that cooks pork, mutton, beef, bakes potatoes and bakes bread. A central production hub for all cooked food.
onceuponatown.building.granary.descripti: A simple storage building that increases the overall stock capacity. Upgrade it to store more resources across the board.
onceuponatown.building.barn.description: A nicely sized storage building that increases the overall stock capacity. Upgrade it to store more resources across the board.
onceuponatown.building.wild_spot.descrip: A wild meadow that adds a natural touch to the village. Grants a production bonus to all buildings.
onceuponatown.building.well.description: A stone well that brings water to the village. Grants a production bonus to all buildings.
onceuponatown.building.lone_place.descri: A small public square that brings life to the village center. Grants a production bonus to all buildings.
onceuponatown.building.lone_garden.descr: A flourishing garden that brightens the village. Grants a production bonus to all buildings.
onceuponatown.building.fountain_place.de: A decorative fountain. Grants a bonus production bonus to all buildings.
onceuponatown.building.merchant_shop.des: A merchant's shop that sells all kind of goods.
onceuponatown.building.market.descriptio: The villagers will gather here to sell or buy goods. Unlocks a merchant that will sell you a commercial contract to send resources to another place.
onceuponatown.building.brownfield.descri: An empty 14x14 plot of cleared land. The village leaves it completely untouched. The perfect place for a player to settle on.
onceuponatown.building.house_slot.descri: An empty house-sized plot placed next to the other houses. Build your own home in the heart of the settlement.
quest.onceuponatown.wood_supplies.title: Wood supplies are low
quest.onceuponatown.wood_supplies.desc: The builder requested us to bring some more wood. Someone know how to hold an axe ?
quest.onceuponatown.stone_supplies.title: Stone supplies are low
quest.onceuponatown.stone_supplies.desc: The builder talked about a new resources that should improve the life here, thicker walls and more heat for winter. We have to collect more of it
quest.onceuponatown.fallen_tree.title: Fallen tree on the road
quest.onceuponatown.fallen_tree.desc: A fallen tree is blocking the road. It would be wise to remove it
quest.onceuponatown.remaining_trunks.des: The builder wasn't in the mood, he left some leftover
quest.onceuponatown.new_visitor.title: A new visitor
quest.onceuponatown.new_visitor.desc: Since the stranger's arrival, something has changed. The builder is waking up earlier and new walls are rising. We should keep an eye on him
quest.onceuponatown.trusting_someone_els: The builder tend to acknowledge the stranger, he brought supplies to build our place. The builder never refused more help, but here that's another level
